"Grabe yung saya kagabi, hanggang ngayon ramdam ko pa rin yung energy! 🔥 
The kings of P-pop, SB19, set the stage on fire at the Qatar National Convention Centre last October 17 for their “Simula at Wakas” World Tour – Doha!

They arrived early morning of October 16, and fans were already waiting to welcome them. Later that day, the group had their press conference at the Mall of Qatar, and everyone was talking about their grand entrance — sabi nga ng netizens, “the kings were truly treated like kings.” 👑

Grabe mga kabayan, hanggang ngayon ramdam ko pa rin yung energy kagabi! 🔥 The kings of P-pop, SB19, set the stage on fire at the Qatar National Convention Centre last October 17 for their “Simula at Wakas” World Tour – Doha!

Yung same day ng arrival nila, SB19 also paid a visit to the Philippine Embassy in Doha, joining Ambassador H.E. Mardomel Celo D. Melicor for the unveiling of the new Sentro Rizal signage. The group proudly represented the Filipino youth as NCCA Youth and Sentro Rizal Ambassadors, showing the world that talent and culture can truly unite us. 🇵🇭

Eto pa ang matindi, A’TIN QATAR didn’t just show up — they showed out! 💜 They prepared a photo booth and gave away exclusive freebies to spread the love and excitement among fans.
Nag enjoy ang mga tao habang naghihintay na magstart ang concert.

At akala ng lahat tapos na… pero hindi pa pala! 💥
SB19 came back on stage for a surprise encore performance of “DAM”, and the crowd went wild!

This concert wasn’t just about music. It was about unity, pride, and the Filipino spirit shining bright here in Qatar.

👏 Hats off to Qabayan Radio 94.3 , Qatar Calendar, Live Nation Philippines, and 1Z Entertainment for bringing another world-class event to our kababayans abroad. Mabuhay ang A’TIN Qatar! 💫" - Daddy Tekky
